goal: In Google Sheets, enter starting values 10 and 20 in A1:A2, formula '=A1*2' in B1, fill down B1 to B5, then copy B1:B5 and paste special values into D1.

input_purposes: URL to create or open a Google Sheet
First starting seed value in A1
required_sequence: Enter seeds '10' in A1 and '20' in A2
Select range B1:B5 and fill down using Cmd+D
Copy range B1:B5 with Cmd+C, navigate to D1, and paste special values (Cmd+Shift+V)
Verify values in Column D and select done
success: Column B contains calculated formula values down to row 5
Column D contains pasted values matching Column B without formulas
